item.title: Flemington tips Saturday 24 October 2026: Brass Lantern the one to beat in Race 7
item.dc:creator: JHR Staff
item.description: Our race-by-race Flemington tips for Saturday 24 October 2026. Brass Lantern (M. Hartigan / T. Marsden) heads our selections in the Group 2 over 1400m, with Southern Compass the value runner on a Soft 5.
item.content:encoded:
Flemington hosts a nine-race card on Saturday 24 October 2026 with the track rated a Soft 5 on Friday and the rail out 6m.

Race 7 – Group 2, 1400m

1. Brass Lantern – Resumes off a sharp Cranbourne trial. The stable says 1400m first-up is ideal. Top pick.

4. Southern Compass – Fitter for a first-up third, handles soft ground. Each-way.

6. Velvet Thunder – New rider T. Marsden, drawn barrier 2. Place.

Scratchings: 9. Harbour Ledger (vet advice).

item.title: Stable mail: trainers talk up their Flemington Saturday chances
item.dc:creator: JHR Staff
item.description: Trainer M. Hartigan is bullish about Southern Compass, while Velvet Thunder's camp is unfazed by a late jockey change ahead of Saturday's Flemington meeting.
item.content:encoded:
"He's never been better," Hartigan said of Southern Compass. "The Soft 5 is no worry, he's won on worse."

Velvet Thunder's connections confirmed T. Marsden takes the ride after the regular jockey was suspended at Caulfield.
